hypothesis.title: KR Behavioral Flow Sentiment Composite — 5th Orthogonal Alpha Source
hypothesis.description: 한국 시장 retail-heavy + foreign-driven 구조 특성 활용. 3-factor empirical-sign composite: (-CR11 Idiosyncratic Return) + (-INV10 Smart Money Flow) + (-INV09 Flow Persistence). 세 factor 모두 한국 empirical sign이 NEGATIVE (full sample t_NW |·| > 4) — 즉 raw 방향과 반대 (contrarian/reversal) 적용 시 alpha 산출. 학술 메커니즘: Daniel-Moskowitz 2016 'Momentum Crashes' (단기 반전), Choe-Kho-Stulz 2005 RFS (한국 foreign trading reversal), Kim-Lee-Park 2017 PBFJ (KR foreign smart money replication, short-term reversal evidence).
hypothesis.expected_role: core_diversifier_5th_source — 1715 H1 (fundamental consensus C01-06) + Q07/M08/Q25 (defense quality) + NEW Vol/Skew (D43+D41+D58 risk-defensive) 와 직교한 behavioral / flow / retail-attention reversal axis. cor=-0.094 (1715 H1과 negative correlation, 더 강한 직교성). 위기 IC=+0.088 normal=+0.036 ratio 2.46× (AX-001 v2 crisis hedge 강력).
hypothesis.why_now: 도훈 mandate 2026-05-12: raw alpha SR 1.02 → target 2.0 gap 0.98. 본 5th source는 Iter5/PD27 1715 H1 fundamental consensus 알파 외 별도 axis (behavioral/flow). 1715 H1 standalone IC=0.047 + 본 T composite IC=0.041 + cor=-0.094 → 두 source linear blend expected IC ≈ 0.062 (Fisher-z 가법 추정 + negative cor 가산 효과). KR top-universe 가용 + PIT C1~C15 정합 (Factor DB connector 경유).

factor_specs.formula: Idiosyncratic monthly return residualized vs market (cross-section z-score per sig_date, sector-neutralized via Z_Sector)
factor_specs.economic_rationale: Daniel-Moskowitz 2016: post-momentum reversal — idio monthly return 상위 → 단기 반전 (Korean retail attention chase reversal). raw direction higher_better 학술 momentum 가정, KR empirical 측정 결과 reversal이 dominant (mean_IC -0.036, t_NW -4.18). 본 composite는 sign flip 적용.
references: Da-Liu-Schaumburg 2014 RFS 27: 1-39 'A Closer Look at the Short-Term Return Reversal'

factor_specs.formula: Composite smart money flow (foreign + institutional net buying signal). Monthly aggregate.
factor_specs.economic_rationale: Choe-Kho-Stulz 2005 RFS: 한국 시장 foreign institutional 거래는 다음 1M 시계열에서 short-term reversal evidence. INV10 raw higher_better 가정 (smart money inflow = positive signal) KR empirical sign NEGATIVE (mean_IC -0.029, t_NW -5.92) — 즉 한국 foreign smart money 과거 1M 매수 종목 → 다음 1M underperform. KR retail attention bias + foreign exit cycle 후 reversal.
references: Choe-Kho-Stulz 2005 RFS 18: 795-829 'Do Domestic Investors Have an Edge?'
Kim-Lee-Park 2017 PBFJ 43: 88-99 (KR foreign trading short-term reversal)

factor_specs.formula: Persistence (autocorrelation) of investor flow over rolling window. Monthly aggregate.
factor_specs.economic_rationale: Flow persistence는 momentum proxy. KR empirical NEGATIVE sign (mean_IC -0.024, t_NW -4.99) — persistent buying 후 reversal. Stambaugh-Yu-Yuan 2015 JF arbitrage asymmetry: 한국 retail-driven 시장에서 flow momentum이 mispricing 누적 후 단기 반전 신호.
references: Stambaugh-Yu-Yuan 2015 JF 70: 1903-1948 'Arbitrage Asymmetry and Idiosyncratic Volatility Puzzle'
